polyester.rest.TriggersService.Problem.description: Trigger request error. Quota exhaustion returns HTTP 429 with RATE_LIMIT_EXCEEDED and rate-limit metadata.

detail.description: Human-readable explanation using REST field names and decimal quote units for price tick sizes; clients must branch on code.

type.description: URI identifying the problem type: https://polyester.dev/problems/ followed by code in lowercase, with hyphens for underscores, for example https://polyester.dev/problems/rate-limit-exceeded for RATE_LIMIT_EXCEEDED.

violations.description: Field-level failures, the violations ConnectRPC returns for the same request, each naming the REST request field; omitted when there are none.

fieldPath.description: REST path of the request field the violation names, for example trigger.stopLoss.triggerPrice; for a ladder refused for one of its orders, that order's zero-based index, for example trigger.ladder.levels[2] for the third order; when no choice of a one-of group was sent, the group, for example trigger.strategy.

tsNs.description: Server timestamp in nanoseconds since epoch (UTC).

subaccountId.description: Optional public subaccount ID. When omitted, subaccount-scoped API keys use their bound subaccount; other callers use their authenticated root account.

clientTriggerId.description: Client-provided trigger ID for idempotency, unique per sub-account, pair and trigger type. While the trigger is active and for 60 seconds after it reaches a terminal status, retrying the create with the identical intent returns the same trigger, and a different intent with the same ID returns CONFLICT_DUPLICATE_CLIENT_TRIGGER_ID. After those 60 seconds the ID is free: a create that uses it is a new intent and creates a new trigger. To learn the outcome of an earlier create after that window, read the triggers with ListTriggers, which return each trigger's client_trigger_id, instead of retrying the create. After a create fails with INTERNAL_ERROR, the ID may already be used: a retry then returns CONFLICT_DUPLICATE_CLIENT_TRIGGER_ID and needs a new client trigger ID. At most 36 bytes in UTF-8 (36 ASCII characters); longer IDs are rejected with INVALID_ARGUMENT.

version.description: Per-trigger state version: 1 for the trigger's first state, then higher for every later published state change, whether a request or the market caused it. A higher version is always newer, and two copies of a trigger with the same version show the same state. GetTrigger, ListTriggers and realtime trigger updates carry the same version for the same state. List results can briefly lag realtime updates, and after a reconnect or a service recovery a realtime update can repeat an earlier state, so keep the copy of each trigger with the highest version and ignore any copy whose version is not higher than the one you hold.

limitPrice.description: Not modifiable: a trigger's child limit price is fixed at create. Setting this field rejects the whole request with ERROR_CODE_TRIGGER_CHILD_PRICE_NOT_MODIFIABLE (InvalidArgument, HTTP 400) and leaves the trigger unchanged; cancel the trigger and create a new one to change the child limit price.

maxSlippageBps.description: Updated maximum allowed slippage in basis points (1 bp = 0.01%). Set to zero to clear the cap. A buy stop-loss or take-profit with a market child accepts 1 to 10000, as at creation. A trailing stop on either side, and a sell stop-loss or take-profit, accept 1 to 9999: 10000 is rejected with ERROR_CODE_MAX_SLIPPAGE_INVALID, because a 100% cap would leave a sell no positive price, and a trailing stop takes none on either side.

maxSlippageTicks.description: Non-negative maximum absolute price delta in Q9 execution-price ticks (1 tick = 1e-9 quote units). Set to zero to clear the cap.

x-poly-enum-descriptions.BASE: BUY-only option: fees are deducted from the received base asset.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.QUOTE: Fees are charged in the quote asset. SELL fees always use quote asset.

x-poly-enum-descriptions.EXPIRE_BOTH: Cancel both maker and taker orders on self-trade.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.EXPIRE_MAKER: Cancel the resting maker order on self-trade.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.EXPIRE_TAKER: Cancel the incoming taker order on self-trade.

x-poly-enum-descriptions.BUY: Buy base asset using quote asset.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.SELL: Sell base asset for quote asset.

x-poly-enum-descriptions.ABOVE: Fire when price >= trigger_price (e.g., take-profit for long, stop-loss for short).
x-poly-enum-descriptions.BELOW: Fire when price <= trigger_price (e.g., stop-loss for long, take-profit for short).

x-poly-enum-descriptions.INDEX_PRICE: The market's index price, aggregated from external exchanges. A trigger that watches it acts only on a current index value: while the index is stale or unavailable the trigger stays armed and waits, and never fires on an outdated value.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.LAST_PRICE: Last traded price on the market (default for spot).
x-poly-enum-descriptions.MARK_PRICE: Mark price for perpetuals; not supported on spot markets.

x-poly-enum-descriptions.ACCOUNT_REPAIR: Ended by the exchange while it recovered your account. The account's open orders on the market were canceled at the same time; place new orders and triggers once the account trades again.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.INTERNAL_ERROR: An internal invariant or processing failure canceled the trigger.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.MARKET_HALTED: The market was halted: the exchange ended every open trigger of the market, attached take-profit and stop-loss included, and released its reserved funds. The market's open orders were canceled at the same time. The market refuses new triggers until it trades again.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.MISSING_REASON_CODE: The terminal state did not contain a cancellation reason.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.OCO: An attached leg ended because its parent order is terminal and another of the parent's legs made the last exit, leaving no position to protect.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.PAIR_DRAIN_ATTACHED_LEG: The market was disabled: the exchange ended the order's attached take-profit or stop-loss and canceled the order and its working exit.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.PAIR_DRAIN_LADDER: The market was disabled: the exchange ended the ladder and canceled its resting levels, releasing their reserved funds.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.PAIR_DRAIN_TRIGGER: The market was disabled: the exchange ended the stop-loss, take-profit or trailing stop and released its reserved funds. The market's open orders were canceled at the same time.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.PAIR_DRAIN_TWAP: The market was disabled: the exchange ended the TWAP and canceled its resting slice, releasing its reserved funds.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.PARENT_CANCELED_NO_FILL: The parent order ended without a fill, so its attached trigger was canceled.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.SELF_TRADE_PREVENTION: Self-trade prevention canceled the trigger's child orders.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.USER_REQUEST: The user explicitly canceled the trigger, or canceled an order that ended it, alone, with a cancel-all or by the dead-man switch: an attached leg's working exit (with oco set, the parent's other legs end with it), or a level of a ladder that ended with nothing filled.

x-poly-enum-descriptions.ACTIVATED: A trailing stop's activation condition was satisfied and tracking began, for a standalone or an attached trailing stop.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.ARMED: An attached take-profit, stop-loss or trailing stop started protecting its parent order's filled quantity, once, when the parent's first fill made it live (or at its resume, when it was paused before that fill). Later fills that resize it, and later pauses and resumes, do not repeat it. An attached trailing stop still reports EVENT_ACTIVATED when it starts tracking.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.FAILED: Trigger became terminal after its next child order could not be admitted.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.FIRED: Trigger fired and may have created a child order.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.FIRE_REFUSED: A fire of the trigger was refused and the trigger stayed live: an attached take-profit, stop-loss or trailing stop waits for the next price through its trigger price, or, refused because its order would be below the market's minimums, waits until its position changes; a trigger refused for a rate limit or an account repair fires again shortly. An attached take-profit, stop-loss or trailing stop whose order self-trade prevention expired against another of the account's resting orders stays live too (TRIGGER_FAILURE_REASON_SELF_TRADE_PREVENTED), reported once while that order blocks it. New trades and price updates do not fire it while the other order is first in line at the best price; once that order is gone or no longer first there, it fires again if its trigger condition still holds. Not terminal: the trigger keeps its status. child_seq names the refused attempt, which placed no child order, and fire_refusal_reason says why; the next fire takes the next child_seq. With TRIGGER_FAILURE_REASON_SELF_TRADE_PREVENTED, child_seq names the expired child order instead, which was placed and canceled by self-trade prevention. A refusal that ends the trigger is EVENT_FAILED instead.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.UPDATED: Trigger configuration or lifecycle state was updated.

x-poly-enum-descriptions.ACCOUNT_REPAIRING: The account was under an automatic repair, so the fire was retried shortly instead of placing its child order.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.ACCOUNT_ROUTING_INVALID: The trigger could not be installed on its market's current route.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.ACCOUNT_UNKNOWN: The account associated with the trigger was not recognized.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.ATTACHED_LEGS_EXCEEDED: The order carried more attached legs than allowed.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.CHILD_ORDER_INCONSISTENT: The trigger's child order did not match the order the trigger requested, so the trigger failed and the child order was canceled.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.CHILD_QTY_RAISE_NOT_ALLOWED: One of the trigger's child orders went past its planned quantity, so the trigger ended.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.CLIENT_ORDER_IDS_EXHAUSTED: The account reserved its maximum number of client order IDs.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.CLIENT_TRIGGER_ID_INVALID: The client trigger ID was not valid.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.CONDITION_FLAGS_INVALID: The trigger's condition flags were not valid.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.CONDITION_PARAMETER_SET: The trigger set a condition parameter its condition does not take.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.CONFLICT_IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REUSE: An idempotency key was reused with different request details.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.DUPLICATE_CLIENT_ID: The child order reused a client order ID that was already accepted.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.DUPLICATE_ORDER_ID: The child order's identifier was already in use by another order.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.EMPTY_BOOK: The order book had no liquidity available for the child order.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.ENGINE_BUSY: The market could not accept the child order at that time.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.FEE_ASSET_INVALID: The fee asset was not valid.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.FEE_ASSET_NOT_ALLOWED: The selected fee asset was not permitted for the child order.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.FEE_CEILING_EXCEEDED: The applicable fee rate exceeded the maximum accepted by the trigger.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.FEE_CEILING_INVALID: The trigger's maximum fee rate was not valid.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.FEE_SCHEDULE_UNAVAILABLE: The fees that apply to the child order could not be determined.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.FOK_INSUFFICIENT_LIQUIDITY: The order book could not fill the entire fill-or-kill child order.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.INDEX_PRICE_UNAVAILABLE: The trigger watches the index price and the market has no index price.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.INSUFFICIENT_FUNDS: The account did not have enough available funds for the child order.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.INTERNAL_ERROR: An internal invariant or processing failure caused the trigger to fail.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.INVALID_ORDER_FLAGS: The child order's flags were not valid.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.INVALID_ORDER_ID: The child order's identifier was not valid.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.INVALID_ORDER_TYPE: The child order's type was not valid.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.INVALID_SIDE: The child order's side was not valid.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.INVALID_SIZING: The child order sizing fields did not form a valid sizing request.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.INVALID_STP_MODE: The child order's self-trade prevention mode was not valid.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.INVALID_TIME_IN_FORCE: The child order's time in force was not accepted.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.LADDER_LEVELS_INVALID: The ladder's number of levels was not valid.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.LADDER_RANGE_TOO_NARROW: The ladder's price range was too narrow for its number of levels.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.LIMIT_CHILD_SLIPPAGE_SET: The trigger set a slippage bound on a LIMIT child order.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.LIMIT_PRICE_INVALID: The trigger's limit price was not valid, including a buy trailing stop's maximum price below the price it watches (the last traded price or the index price) when it was placed without an activation price.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.MARKET_CAP_VIOLATION: The market child order exceeded the configured execution cap.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.MARKET_HALTED: Trading was halted for the requested market.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.MARKET_PRICE_UNAVAILABLE: A current market price was unavailable for sizing or validation.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.MARKET_QUOTE_STALE: The market's reference quote was too old to price the market child order.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.MARKET_QUOTE_UNHEALTHY: The market's reference quote could not be used to price the market child order.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.MAX_NOTIONAL: The child order notional was above the pair's maximum.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.MAX_OPEN_ORDERS_PER_PAIR: The account had its maximum number of resting orders in this market when a limit TWAP slice was due.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.MAX_OPEN_ORDERS_TOTAL: The account had its maximum number of open orders.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.MAX_QUANTITY: The child order quantity was above the pair's maximum.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.MAX_QUOTE_DEBIT_TOO_SMALL: The maximum quote debit could not fund the minimum valid child order.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.MAX_SLIPPAGE_INVALID: The maximum slippage could not produce a valid execution price bound.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.MIN_NOTIONAL: The child order value was below the pair's minimum notional.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.MIN_QUANTITY: The child order quantity was below the pair's minimum quantity.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.MISSING_REASON_CODE: The terminal state did not contain a failure reason.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.MODE_NOT_SUPPORTED: The market does not support a trigger of this shape, including a trailing stop whose child order is not a market order when it fires.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.MODIFICATION_REQUIRES_REPLACE: The requested modification required replacing the trigger instead.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.NEW_ACCOUNT_CAPACITY_REACHED: The venue could not admit the account to this market.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.ORDER_ALREADY_TERMINAL: The referenced order had already reached a terminal state.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.ORDER_ID_CONFLICT: The child order's identifier was held by a different order.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.ORDER_LIMITS_UNAVAILABLE: The market's order limits weren't set yet when the trigger fired.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.ORDER_SEQUENCE_EXHAUSTED: The account used every order identifier available to it in this market.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.ORDER_TYPE_NOT_ALLOWED_IN_AUCTION: The trigger's order type isn't taken while the market is in an auction call.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.ORDER_UNKNOWN: An order referenced by the trigger was not found.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.PAIR_BACKLOGGED: The trading pair was busy with the account's earlier requests.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.PAIR_DISABLED: The trading pair was not accepting new orders.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.PAIR_POST_ONLY: The market took only post-only orders when the trigger fired.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.POLICY_MARKET_DENY: Account policy did not permit trading in this market.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.POLICY_MAX_NOTIONAL: The child order would have exceeded the policy notional limit.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.POLICY_MAX_OPEN_ORDERS: The child order would have exceeded the policy open-order limit.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.POLICY_SPOT_TRADE_DENY: Account policy did not permit spot trading.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.POLICY_UNAVAILABLE: The account's trading policy could not be evaluated.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.POST_ONLY_CROSS: The post-only child order would have immediately taken liquidity.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.POST_ONLY_NOT_ALLOWED_IN_AUCTION: The trigger's post-only order isn't taken while the market is in an auction call.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.PRICE_BAND_VIOLATION: The child order price was outside the allowed market price band.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.PRICE_LEVELS_EXHAUSTED: The market held its maximum number of price levels.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.PRICE_LEVEL_QUANTITY_LIMIT: The child order would take the total quantity resting at its price past the most a price level can hold, even if some quantity still fits; it was not placed.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.QTY_INVALID: The trigger's quantity was not valid.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.RATE_LIMITED: The request exceeded an applicable rate limit.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.REDUCE_ONLY_BLOCKED: The reduce-only child order would not have reduced the position.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.RISK_LIMIT: The child order would have exceeded an account risk limit.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.SELF_TRADE_PREVENTED: Self-trade prevention expired the order of an attached take-profit, stop-loss or trailing stop because it would have traded with another of the account's resting orders. Reported only as a fire refusal reason (EVENT_FIRE_REFUSED): the attached order stays active. New trades and price updates do not fire it while the other order is first in line at the best price; once that order is gone or no longer first there, it fires again if its trigger condition still holds.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.SETTLEMENT_BACKLOGGED: The account had too many filled orders whose settlement had not completed.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.SLIPPAGE_BOUNDS_CONFLICT: The trigger set both slippage bounds where only one is accepted.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.SLIPPAGE_BPS_INVALID: The trigger's slippage bound in basis points was not valid.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.SLIPPAGE_TICKS_INVALID: The trigger's slippage bound in ticks was not valid.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.STALE_QUOTE: The quote used to size or validate the child order was no longer current.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.STEP_SIZE: The child order quantity was not aligned to the pair's step size.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.STP_MODE_NOT_ALLOWED: The child order's self-trade prevention mode was not accepted.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.TICK_SIZE: The child order price was not aligned to the pair's tick size.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.TRAILING_DISTANCE_INVALID: The configured trailing distance was invalid.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.TRIGGERS_EXHAUSTED: The market held its maximum number of triggers.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.TRIGGER_DIRECTION_INVALID: The trigger direction was not valid.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.TRIGGER_FIRE_LIMIT_REACHED: The trigger could not fire again.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.TRIGGER_PRICE_INVALID: The configured trigger price was invalid.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.TRIGGER_PRICE_SOURCE_UNSUPPORTED: The selected trigger price source was not supported.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.TRIGGER_WOULD_TRIGGER_IMMEDIATELY: The trigger price, or a trailing stop's activation price, was already reached by the price the trigger watches when the trigger was submitted (at or past it), so the trigger would have fired or activated at once. It never armed and sent no order; its reserved funds were released. A price that reaches it after submission fires or activates the trigger normally.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.TWAP_CAPACITY_REACHED: The market had no room for another TWAP order.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.TWAP_INTERVAL_INVALID: The TWAP interval was not valid.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.UNKNOWN_SYMBOL: The requested trading pair was not recognized.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.UNSUPPORTED_FIELD_SET: The trigger set a field that must be left unset.

x-poly-enum-descriptions.ARMED: Trigger admitted and actively evaluating conditions.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.CANCELED: Trigger was canceled. The cancel reason states why, for example a user request or another attached leg's exit closing its parent's position. A ladder is canceled when the ladder itself is canceled. A ladder whose child orders the user canceled with none filled, one by one, with a cancel-all or by the dead man's switch, is canceled too, with a user request reason, once none of them remains open. A ladder whose child orders were canceled only by self-trade prevention, or by the exchange while it recovered the account, with none filled, completes instead.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.COMPLETED: Trigger completed. A ladder completes once none of its child orders remains open and at least one of them was placed on the book, unless it ends canceled (see STATUS_CANCELED). A ladder that filled any quantity completes however its other child orders ended. Some of its child orders may have been rejected. Completed does not mean the ladder filled: its executed quantity and executed levels state what filled, and each child order's own status states how it ended.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.CREATED: Trigger was created and is pending activation.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.FAILED: Trigger failed (for example, reservation failure, child order rejection). A ladder fails when every child order was rejected before it was placed on the book; the failure reason is the first rejected child order's.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.PAUSED: Trigger is paused (user-initiated, can be resumed).
x-poly-enum-descriptions.RUNNING: Trigger is actively executing (for example, TWAP slices in progress).

x-poly-enum-descriptions.LADDER: Ladder/Scaled: Multiple orders placed across a price range.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.STOP_LOSS: Stop-loss: fires when the price crosses a threshold.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.TAKE_PROFIT: Take-profit: fires when the price crosses a threshold.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.TRAILING_STOP: Trailing stop: dynamic stop that trails price by a distance.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.TWAP: TWAP: Time-Weighted Average Price execution over a duration.

BrokerApiKeyAuth.description: Broker API key, sent as a bearer token and accepted only by the QuickSwap broker API. The broker API key is a server credential. Call this API from the broker's backend, never from a browser or mobile app. The broker's members create, rotate and revoke keys through the QuickSwap broker API, and a key may rotate itself.

info.description:
Public trading API for market makers and integrators.
Connect RPC over HTTP/1.1 and HTTP/2 with JSON and Protobuf.
info.title: Polyester API

get.description: List triggers for an account with optional symbol, status, and trigger-type filters.

parameters.description: Opaque keyset cursor returned by the previous response.
parameters.name: pageToken

parameters.description: Repeatable or comma-separated TriggerStatus enum names
parameters.name: status

get.x-poly-rest-note: This operation uses REST-friendly types: decimal strings for quantities/prices, base58 strings for IDs.

post.description: Create a standalone trigger order. Supports stop, trailing, TWAP, and ladder trigger configurations.

400.description: The trigger was not created: an invalid or refused request. code names the reason, and violations name the refused field, or the refused order of a ladder (LADDER_LEVEL_REJECTED).

413.description: REQUEST_TOO_LARGE: the request body is over the 256 KiB limit; nothing was done.

post.x-poly-rest-note: This operation uses REST-friendly types: decimal strings for quantities/prices, base58 strings for IDs.

delete.description: Cancel a trigger by trigger ID and release its reserved quantity.
delete.x-poly-rest-note: This operation uses REST-friendly types: decimal strings for quantities/prices, base58 strings for IDs.

get.description: Retrieve a single trigger by trigger ID, including lifecycle state and strategy-specific fields.

404.description: NOT_FOUND: the caller can read no trigger with this ID (none exists, it belongs to another account, or it is outside the selected subaccount).

get.x-poly-rest-note: This operation uses REST-friendly types: decimal strings for quantities/prices, base58 strings for IDs.

put.description: Modify a trigger by trigger ID using a limited patch for trigger pricing and trailing/slippage parameters. Supported for stop-loss, take-profit and trailing-stop triggers; ladder and TWAP triggers support only cancel and answer TRIGGER_NOT_MODIFIABLE.

parameters.description: Optional trading pair symbol, e.g. BTC-USDT, as an alternative to symbol in the body. When both are given they must be the same.
parameters.name: symbol

400.description: The trigger was not modified: an invalid or refused request. Off-tick triggerPrice or activationPrice returns PRICE_TICK_SIZE with that field and ruleId tick_size, with or without symbol. A limitPrice change returns TRIGGER_CHILD_PRICE_NOT_MODIFIABLE; any positive trailingDistance is allowed regardless of the price tick. violations name the refused REST field.

413.description: REQUEST_TOO_LARGE: the request body is over the 256 KiB limit; nothing was done.

put.x-poly-rest-note: This operation uses REST-friendly types: decimal strings for quantities/prices, base58 strings for IDs.

get.description: List append-only trigger events for a trigger, including child-order actions, with optional event-category filtering and reverse-time pagination. A trigger the caller can read that has no event yet answers an empty list.

parameters.description: Optional TriggerEventType enum name, for example FIRED. Omit to return all events.
parameters.name: eventType

parameters.description: Opaque keyset cursor returned by the previous response.
parameters.name: pageToken

404.description: NOT_FOUND: the caller can read no trigger with this ID (none exists, it belongs to another account, or it is outside the selected subaccount), as for Get Trigger.

get.x-poly-rest-note: This operation uses REST-friendly types: decimal strings for quantities/prices, base58 strings for IDs.

400.description: The trigger was not modified: an invalid or refused request. code names the reason, and violations name the refused field.

413.description: REQUEST_TOO_LARGE: the request body is over the 256 KiB limit; nothing was done.

post.x-poly-rest-note: This operation uses REST-friendly types: decimal strings for quantities/prices, base58 strings for IDs.

post.description: Resume a paused trigger by trigger ID. Supported for stop-loss, take-profit and trailing-stop triggers; ladder and TWAP triggers support only cancel and answer TRIGGER_NOT_MODIFIABLE.

parameters.description: Optional trading pair symbol, e.g. BTC-USDT, as an alternative to symbol in the body. When both are given they must be the same.
parameters.name: symbol

400.description: The trigger was not modified: an invalid or refused request. code names the reason, and violations name the refused field.

413.description: REQUEST_TOO_LARGE: the request body is over the 256 KiB limit; nothing was done.
